vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule and the release-age gate (Renovate defaults); label them so they are visible among the chore PRs.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once the required checks pass
Automerge GitHub Action digest and non-major bumps; the major rule below takes majors back.
Vendure upgrades are a deliberate PR with a changeset, never automerged
Majors wait for a click on the dependency dashboard, then land as a reviewed PR. Last rule so it also reclaims the GitHub Actions and Vendure matches above.
